page_title: LEV 4-0 PAU | Bayer Leverkusen v St. Pauli 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
90+2' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Dangerous play by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli). Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
88' Taichi Hara (St. Pauli) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
86' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
85' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) causes Nikola Vasilj little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
84' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
83' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. St. Pauli have a free kick from a promising distance.
82' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) replaces Manolis Saliakas.
82' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Martijn Kaars and he is replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
82' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
81' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
80' The substitution is prepared. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Exequiel Palacios.
78' 4 - 0 Nice piece of skill by Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) as he collected a pass and fired an unstoppable thunderbolt into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
78' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner which is cleared.
76' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner with a short pass.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
73' Bayer Leverkusen hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
72' A substitution has been made. Alejandro Grimaldo goes off and Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
70' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) makes a strong challenge and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
69' Alexander Blessin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Taichi Hara (St. Pauli) replacing Jackson Irvine.
69' It's time for a substitution. Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) comes on in place of James Sands.
66' The corner kick from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
64' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

62' That didn't go as planned! Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Nikola Vasilj, who easily kept it out.
61' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
59' Kasper Hjulmand prepares a substitution. Patrik Schick is replaced by Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen).
59' Here is a change. Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) is going off and Kasper Hjulmand gives the last tactical orders to Arthur.
56' The total number of attempts is 5:8.
54' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

52' 3 - 0 Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header home from close range after a fine cross following the corner kick. The ball bounces in off the bottom of the left post. He alters the score – 3:0.
52' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
49' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
46' Half-time substitution. Kasper Hjulmand decided to make a change. Ibrahim Maza is replaced by Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) probably handled the ball.
41' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
39' The referee blows his whistle after Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
36' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) fires a volley towards goal, but the ball sails well wide of the left post.
36' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' Sven Jablonski has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli).
33' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
31' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post.
29' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
27' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
23' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sven Jablonski has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
21' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nikola Vasilj, who smothers the ball.
20' The ball possession at the moment is 69:31.
17' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
14' 2 - 0 Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) latches onto a brilliant cross and produces a perfect header that goes inside the left post to give the goalkeeper no chance!

14' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Nikola Vasilj pulls off a brilliant save.
13' 1 - 0 Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
13' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
9' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
7' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
6' St. Pauli are ruled offside.
5' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
5' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli win a corner kick.
2' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
1' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
